walkthroughs.body_html:
Peak height = activation energy.

End vs start = enthalpy change.
Catalyst lowers peak but does NOT change start or end heights.

Higher pressure raises NH3 yield in Haber.

But high pressure is expensive and dangerous.

mcqs.q: Why not use very high pressures industrially?
